In the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, successive lords of the {{ill|Owari Domain|Q1062072|qid=Q1062072}} donated shrine lands and built a protective cover over the shrine gate<ref name="kamo" />.

A great flood of the {{ill|Kiso River|Q779607|qid=Q779607}} in June {{ill|1586|ab|1586|af|1586|als|1586|am|1586 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1586|ar|1586|ary|1586|arz|1586|ast|1586|avk|1586|az|1586|azb|۱۵۸۶ (میلادی)|bar|1586|bcl|1586|be|1586|be_x_old|1586|bg|1586|bn|১৫৮৬|bpy|মারি ১৫৮৬|br|1586|bs|1586.|ca|1586|cdo|1586 nièng|ceb|1586|ckb|١٥٨٦|crh|1586|cs|1586|cv|1586|cy|1586|da|1586|de|1586|diq|1586|el|1586|eml|1586|eo|1586|es|1586|et|1586|eu|1586|fa|۱۵۸۶ (میلادی)|fi|1586|fo|1586|fr|1586|frr|1586|fur|1586|fy|1586|ga|1586|gan|1586年|gcr|1586|gd|1586|gl|1586|he|1586|hi|१५८६|hr|1586.|ht|1586 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1586|hy|1586|hyw|1586 թուական|ia|1586|id|1586|ilo|1586|io|1586|is|1586|it|1586|ja|1586年|jv|1586|ka|1586|kaa|1586|kk|1586 жыл|ko|1586년|krc|1586 джыл|la|1586|lb|1586|lij|1586|lmo|1586|lt|1586 m.|lv|1586. gads|mai|१५८६|map_bms|1586|mdf|1586|mg|1586|mhr|1586|mi|1586|mk|1586|mr|इ.स. १५८६|mrj|1586 и|ms|1586|my|၁၅၈၆|mzn|۱۵۸۶|nah|1586|nap|1586|nds|1586|new|सन् १५८६|nl|1586|nn|1586|no|1586|nrm|1586|nso|1586|oc|1586|or|୧୫୮୬|os|1586-æм аз|pl|1586|pnb|1586|pt|1586|qu|1586|ro|1586|ru|1586 год|rue|1586|sa|१५८६|sah|1586|scn|1586|sd|1586ع|se|1586|sh|1586.|shn|1586|simple|1586|sk|1586|sl|1586|smn|1586|sq|1586|sr|1586|su|1586|sv|1586|sw|1586|ta|1586|tg|Соли 1586|th|พ.ศ. 2129|tk|1586|tl|1586|tly|1586|tr|1586|tt|1586 ел|uk|1586|ur|1586ء|uz|1586|vec|1586|vi|1586|vls|1586|wa|1586|war|1586|wuu|1586年|xmf|1586|yi|1586|zh|1586年|zh_min_nan|1586 nî|zh_yue|1586年|qid=Q6739}} ({{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|ckb|تێنشۆ (سەردەمی مۆمۆیاما)|fa|تنشو|fr|Ère Tenshō (Momoyama)|ja|天正|ko|덴쇼 (아즈치모모야마 시대)|ro|Era Tenshō (Momoyama)|ru|Тэнсё (Адзути-Момояма)|simple|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|sr|Теншо (Момојама период)|sv|Tenshō|tr|Tenshō (Momoyama)|zh|天正 (日本)|qid=Q1145058}} 14) significantly changed the river's main channel and split {{ill|Haguri District|hu|Haguri körzet|ja|葉栗郡|ko|하구리군 (아이치현)|pl|Powiat Haguri|sr|Област Хагури|zh|葉栗郡|qid=Q1032507}} in two. The region on the right bank became {{ill|Mino Province|Q864156|qid=Q864156}} {{ill|Haguri district|Q11610214|qid=Q11610214}}. Therefore, for parishioners in Hashima District, Mino Province, a branch shrine was established in 1599 ({{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} 4) at Minami-oyobi Village, Hashima District (present Masaki-chō Minami-oyobi, {{ill|Hashima, Gifu|Q819595|qid=Q819595}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|Q131277|qid=Q131277}}).

In January {{ill|1946|Q18610|qid=Q18610}} ({{ill|Shōwa era|Q327567|qid=Q327567}} 21), it was scheduled for promotion to prefectural shrine, but due to postwar {{ill|Shinto Directive|fa|بخشنامه شینتو|fr|Directive shinto|id|Pengarahan Shinto|ja|神道指令|zh|神道指令|qid=Q3029647}}, it was never ranked as kensha.

== Precinct ==
The spring water that wells up in the precinct is called "Tamanoi Reisen" (Tamanoi spring / Tamai spring), and is the origin of the local place name "Tamanoi." This water is said to have healed the eye disease of {{ill|Empress Kōmyō|Q837932|qid=Q837932}}. Faith in healing eye disease continues today.

== Cultural properties ==
== Aichi Prefecture designated tangible cultural property ==
* Kishin mask (craft)

== Ichinomiya City designated tangible cultural properties ==
* Old shrine gate (building)
* Noh masks (one male and one female face) (sculpture)
* Two swords (craft)
* Ancient mirror (craft)
* Ancient mirror (chrysanthemum-scatter twin-sparrow mirror)
* Ancient mirror (auspicious-flower butterfly twin-phoenix mirror)
* Ancient mirror (auspicious-flower twin-phoenix octagonal mirror)
* Two kishin masks, Muromachi period
* Female mask, Muromachi period
* Sacred bell
* Wooden seated monk statue, Muromachi period
* Spring water of Tamanoi (historic site)
